title: 49 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Coffee Shop & Bakery)
description:
Learn 49 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Coffee Shop & Bakery · 咖啡馆与面包店
1:23  Inspiration · 灵感
2:38  Gratitude · 感恩

PHRASE LIST

COFFEE SHOP & BAKERY · 咖啡馆与面包店
• Can I get a cappuccino to go? - 我想打包一杯卡布奇诺，可以吗？  [Wo xiang da bao yi bei KA BU QI NUO, ke yi ma?]
• What kind of bread do you recommend? - 你们最推荐哪种面包？  [Ni men zui tui jian na zhong Mian Bao?]
• This aroma is making me smile. - 这香味让我忍不住笑。  [Zhe xiang wei rang wo ren bu zhu xiao.]
• Do you have almond croissants today? - 今天有杏仁可颂吗？  [Jin tian you xing ren ke song ma?]
• Could I try the house bread? - 我能尝尝你们的招牌面包吗？  [Wo neng chang chang ni men de zhao pai Mian Bao ma?]
• I’ll take that slice, please. - 我要那一片蛋糕，麻烦了。  [Wo yao na yi pian dan gao, ma fan le.]

INSPIRATION · 灵感
• Write one line, then stop - 写下一句就够了  [Xie yi xia ju jiu gou le]
• Call it a sign, right now - 就把它当作暗示  [Jiu ba ta dang zuo an shi]
• I need quiet, and then ideas - 我先安静一下，灵感就来了  [Wo xian an jing yi xia, linggan jiu lai le]
• Let the sky reset my mind - 看看天空，脑子就清醒了  [Kan kan tian kong, nao zi jiu qing xing le]
• I trust this sudden pull - 我相信这种突然的牵引  [Wo xiangxin zhe zhong tu ran de qian yin]
• Small walk, big spark - 走一走，灵感就冒出来  [Zou yi zou, linggan jiu mao chu lai]

GRATITUDE · 感恩
• Thank you for noticing my effort. - 谢谢你看见我的努力。  [Xièxie nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de nǔlì.]
• I appreciate you checking in again. - 我很感激你又来关心我。  [Wǒ hěn gǎnjī nǐ yòu lái guān xīn wǒ.]
• Your patience kept me from quitting. - 你的耐心让我没有放弃。  [Nǐ de nàixīn ràng wǒ méiyǒu fàngqì.]
• I’m grateful you stood by me. - 我很感恩你一直站在我这边。  [Wǒ hěn gǎn'ēn nǐ yìzhí zhàn zài wǒ zhèbiān.]
• Thank you for calming my mind. - 谢谢你让我心里安静下来。  [Xièxie nǐ ràng wǒ xīnli ānjìng xiàlái.]
• I feel thankful for your honest feedback. - 我感谢你真诚的反馈。  [Wǒ gǎnxiè nǐ zhēnchéng de fǎkuì.]

HAPPINESS · 幸福
• I name my happiness out loud. - 我把幸福说出来。  [Wo ba xingfu shuo chulai.]
• I stop rushing and feel present. - 我不再赶时间，开始感受当下。  [Wo bu zai gan shijian, kai shi gan shou dangxia.]
• Small wins, big warmth inside. - 小小的胜利，也能带来温暖。  [Xiao xiao de shengli, ye neng dailai wen nuan.]
• I take a warm drink break. - 我给自己来一杯热饮。  [Wo gei zi ji lai yi bei re yin.]
• I let today be enough. - 我允许今天就这样就够了。  [Wo yun xu jin tian jiu zhe yang jiu gou le.]
• I text thanks, then breathe. - 我发一句感谢，然后深呼吸。  [Wo fa yi ju ganxie, ran hou shen hu xi.]

SHOPPING & PRICES · 购物与价格
• Show me the final total, please. - 请把最终总价给我看看。  [QING ba ZUIZHONG ZONGJIA gei WO kan kan.]
• Is there a student discount? - 有学生优惠吗？  [YOu XUESHENG YOUHUI ma?]
• Can I pay with my card here? - 我能在这儿刷卡吗？  [WO neng zai ZHE er SHUA KA ma?]
• Do you have it in a cheaper color? - 有便宜点的颜色吗？  [YOu BIANI dian de YANSE ma?]
• Wait, is this on sale today? - 等等，今天打折吗？  [DENG DENG, JINtian DAzHE ma?]
• I want the best value, not just cheap. - 我想要更划算的，不只是便宜。  [WO XIANG YAO GENG HUASUAN de, bu ZHI SHI PIANI.]
• What does warranty cover, exactly? - 保修具体包括哪些？  [BAO XIU JUti baoKUO naXIE?]

FRIENDSHIP · 友谊
• Thanks for being my steady friend - 谢谢你一直做我的贴心朋友。  [Xièxie nǐ yìzhí zuò wǒ de tiēxīn péngyou.]
• I can count on your honesty - 我信得过你的真诚。  [Wǒ xìndéguò nǐ de zhēnchéng.]
• When I’m down, you notice - 我难过的时候，你会看出来。  [Wǒ nán guò de shíhou, nǐ huì kàn chūlái.]
• You make tough days feel lighter - 你让我觉得难的日子也轻一点。  [Nǐ ràng wǒ juéde nán de rìzi yě qīng yídiǎn.]
• We celebrate small wins, too - 小小的进步，我们也一起庆祝。  [Xiǎoxiǎo de jìnbù, wǒmen yě yìqǐ qìngzhù.]
• Call me, I’ll pick up fast - 你一打来电话，我就尽快接。  [Nǐ yí dǎlái diànhuà, wǒ jiù jìnkuài jiē.]

FORGIVENESS · 宽恕
• I forgive, and I still set limits - 我宽恕你，但我仍然会设定界限  [Wǒ kuānshù nǐ, dàn wǒ réngrán huì shèdìng jièxiàn]
• I forgive, then we repair together - 我宽恕了，我们再一起把关系修复好  [Wǒ kuānshù le, wǒmen zài yìqǐ bǎ guānxì xiūfù hǎo]
• I let it pass without keeping scoring - 我把这事放下，不再计较得失  [Wǒ bǎ zhè shì fàngxià, bù zài jìjiào déshī]
• I can be kind, even hurt - 我可以善待你，尽管我仍然受伤  [Wǒ kěyǐ shàn dài nǐ, jìngrán wǒ réngrán shòushāng]
• I forgive now, for my own quiet - 我现在选择宽恕，为的是让自己安静下来  [Wǒ xiànzài xuǎnzé kuānshù, wèile de shì ràng zìjǐ ānjìng xiàlái]
• No revenge, just a fresh start - 我不报复，只想重新开始  [Wǒ bù bàofù, zhǐxiǎng chóngxīn kāishǐ]

EMERGENCY & HEALTH · 紧急情况与健康
• Is anyone choking right now? - 有人现在噎住了吗？  [Yǒu rén xiànzài yē zhù le ma?]
